A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT

Noncomplex conditions do not require intensive monitoring, do not involve multiple interacting high acuity comorbidities, and do not necessitate advanced interventions such as therapeutic diets delivered via enteral or parenteral nutrition. (14) (16) 'Nutrition care services' means any part or all of the following services provided within a systematic process: (A) Assessing and evaluating the nutritional needs of individuals and groups and determining resources and constraints in a practice setting, including ordering nutrition related laboratory tests to check and track nutrition status; (B) Identifying nutrition problems and establishing priorities, goals, … nutrition interventions in health and disease, including nutrition counseling on food and prescription drug interactions; (E) Developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care processes; or (F) Evaluating, making changes in, and maintaining appropriate standards of quality in food and nutrition services.
